- **CI workflows and leg script:** test_ci_workflows.py — `CiWorkflowTest` pins ci.yml's `build/**` trigger, a rust-cache (matched by its `Swatinem/rust-cache@` prefix) with a `main` + `build/` save rule on every compiling job but the cache-less `coverage` and the restore-only `a11y` and, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, `stand-repeat` (each carries the test job's `shared-key` and `save-if: false`), the fast four with no `needs` and every other job needing all four, each linux job's leg through `ci-leg.sh` (the leg present in the script's list), each leg job's own `if: failure()` log upload under `target/ci-logs/` kept 7 days (the coverage job's second upload success-only), no `secrets.`, no perl rewrite, the matrix platforms windows/macos/ios/android, every `uses:` pinned to a 40-hex commit SHA, every `dtolnay/rust-toolchain` step naming its `toolchain`, a workflow-level `permissions` of `contents: read` with no job grant, an a11y job named for accessibility, the coverage job's `coverage-report` upload of `target/coverage/` kept 7 days, and every package install bounded — no step's `run` naming `apt-get`, each step that calls `apt-install.sh` being that script and package names with no option (the `ci-scripts` one behind its PyYAML guard), the jobs that call it exactly the ten of `INSTALL_JOBS` (nine until 2026-10-14-quality-gates, `stand-repeat` added, as it is to `LINUX_JOB_LEGS` and `RESTORE_ONLY_JOBS`), and the one action step that installs packages, the matrix job's, carrying an integer `timeout-minutes` above 0 (`test_o_package_installs_are_bounded`, .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:218-235); `UpstreamGuardTest` pins the `DioxusLabs/blitz` repository guard on every job of publish-browser, wpt and wpt-post-results; `LegScriptTest` runs `ci-leg.sh` in a temp dir with a `cargo` shim on PATH
 — a failing leg exits non-zero and writes its log, the log is truncated at the leg's start, an unknown leg exits 2, the `doc` leg documents the whole workspace (`--workspace --no-deps --locked`), and the `audit`, `a11y` and `coverage` legs dispatch to cargo and write their log — since 2026-10-14-quality-gates the `audit` row asserting `--workspace`, `--all-features`, `advisories` and `licenses`, the `coverage` row two cases over a seeded lcov (the crates at their floors exit 0 with `3 of 3`, escher-driver one line under exits 1 with `1 of 3 … under`), a `clippy` case (the workspace line, then the blitz-dom line) and two `stand-repeat` cases (the three rounds; the stop at the first red) (.github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:326-374) — the `a11y` row pinning all six test files in order, `accessibility_hidden`, `accessibility_roles`, `focusability_updates`, `stand_keyboard`, `stand_contrast`, `stand_accessibility_ids`, the last three added at 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions (.github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:298-299); `InstallScriptTest` runs the CI install script `.github/scripts/apt-install.sh` in a session of its own, against a stand-in `sudo`, `apt-get` and, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, `dpkg` first on PATH with the real `timeout`, and kills that process group when the test's own wait bound fires — eight tests (five until that chunk): a healthy install runs one update and one install, and no repair, a failed attempt is tried again from `update`, every attempt failing exits 1 after three attempts and never 124 or 137, a stalled call ends at its bound and is tried again, an install failed by its bound is repaired before the next attempt, a failed repair fails its attempt in phase `repair`, and a bad call
 — nine of them: no package, a name outside the closed form, an unknown option, an option with no value or a malformed one, `--attempts 0`, `--bound 0` — exits 2 before anything runs (.github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:381-495; .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:425-459; the whole file's classes .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:103-499); four mutation controls of 2026-10-09-audit-corrections-agent-surfaces each turned a named test red and were restored with the file's sha256 compared — the script's loop cut to one attempt (three tests red, the retry test among them), its bounded `update` replaced by a bare `sudo apt-get update` (the stalled-call test red at its own 30 s wait), one workflow step put back to its bare `apt-get` line and the `timeout-minutes` line removed (the invariant red each time) — and the invariant read red on the still-unedited workflow, 11 failures (escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-09-audit-corrections-agent-surfaces/evidence/controls.md); the CI-scripts leg runs 100 tests over seven test files — test_ci_workflows.py's 33, test_wpt_diff_to_pr.py's 7, test_agent_run.py's 14, test_cold_agent.py's 33, test_wpt_area_changes.py's 5, test_blitz_tests_targets.py's 1 and test_coverage_floor.py's 7 — as measured at 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test (`ci-leg.sh ci-scripts`: `Ran 100 tests`, `OK`; test_cold_agent.py 27 → 33) and green at CI#38713461945 on `539defba`; 94, with test_cold_agent.py's 27, as measured at 2026-10-14-quality-gates (`ci-leg.sh fast`: `Ran 94 tests`, `OK`; +7 floor, +5 leg and +3 install cases) and green at CI#38692629940 on `d44090eb`; 79, with test_ci_workflows.py's 25 over six files, as measured at 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship (`ci-leg.sh fast`: `Ran 79 tests`, `OK`; +1, upstream #1183) and green at CI#38422391931 on `a6c24d24`;

subject: gate-coverage-floor
text:
- **Coverage floors:** since 2026-10-14-quality-gates the `coverage` leg ends with `.github/scripts/coverage_floor.py` over three per-crate line floors — `packages/escher-driver` 97 %, `packages/dioxus-native-dom` 83 %, `packages/blitz-test-harness` 90 % — on the founder's «3 крейта, на 1 пункт ниже (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-14, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label); at that tree they read 98.34 % (4784/4865), 84.25 % and 91.69 %, the verdict `coverage floor: 3 of 3 crates at or above their floors` on the dev host and in CI#38692629940, and a floor of 99 exits 1 naming escher-driver on the same lcov (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:40-47; .github/scripts/coverage_floor.py:70-101; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-quality-gates/evidence/coverage-floor.md). Since 2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts both `cargo llvm-cov` lines take `--ignore-filename-regex 'keyboard_compat\.rs$'`, excluding dioxus-native-dom's crate-private `keyboard_compat.rs` — upstream's temporary keyboard-types 0.7/0.8 bridge, 564 lines whose 530 conversion arms no test of ours reaches — until escher takes upstream's retirement of it, on the operator's P4 answer (inputs#I2 of that chunk); the floors and `coverage_floor.py` are unchanged; at the merged tree dioxus-native-dom reads 2472/2934 = 84.25 % (equal to the baseline), escher-driver 98.19 %, blitz-test-harness 91.69 %, the leg ending `coverage floor: 3 of 3 crates at or above their floors` with no `keyboard_compat` record in `target/coverage/lcov.info`; the exclusion is pinned by `test_coverage_leg_reaches_the_floor_on_each_crate` asserting `--ignore-filename-regex` among the leg's words (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:41-42; .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:44-45; .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:330 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts/report.md).
 Upstream retires `keyboard_compat.rs` in `286874cc1` (Dioxus 0.8.0-alpha.3), a commit escher has not taken, so the file stays in the tree and both `--ignore-filename-regex 'keyboard_compat\.rs$'` lines stand, the three floors and `coverage_floor.py` unchanged; the exclusion lifts when escher takes that move, owned by the `.andromeda/residuals.md` line of the left-out upstream delta (target: next) — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-24-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship/report.md.
 A `*_tests.rs` `#[path]` test-child file is no record of the per-crate reading — the coverage job's per-file report lists none, `mcp_tests.rs` and `schema_tests.rs` included — so a test module moved out of line moves its crate's reading with no line of code changed: since 2026-10-19-test-splits escher-driver read 4266/4350 = 98.07 %, since 2026-10-19-visual-lint, which added lint.rs, 4634/4732 = 97.93 %, and since 2026-10-20-load-wait it reads 4695/4794 = 97.93 %, the 97 % floor holding, 3 of 3 crates still at or above their floors (as measured at the `Coverage report` job of CI#39360124515, read in escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-load-wait/evidence/ci.md); read again with the stand checks' named list, the floors and `coverage_floor.py` unchanged: escher-driver 4918/5019 = 97.99 %, dioxus-native-dom 2740/3202 = 85.57 %, blitz-test-harness 949/1008 = 94.15 %, `coverage floor: 3 of 3 crates at or above their floors`, equal to CI#40105170961 (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-24-stand-requirement-sweep/report.md, its gate entry 16)
